
```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(svglite)

output_dir <- file.path("results", "rsa")
plot_data_file <- file.path(output_dir, "rsa_plot_data.rds")
if (!file.exists(plot_data_file)) {
  stop("Run ../1_maincode/1.1_RSA_main.Rmd before generating RSA figures.")
}

rsa_plot_data <- readRDS(plot_data_file)
list2env(rsa_plot_data, envir = environment())
network_rdm_names <- setNames(network_names, network_cols)
```

```{r helper-functions}
save_plot_bundle <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300) {
  stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename)
  svglite::svglite(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".svg")), width = width, height = height, bg = "transparent")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height, family = "Arial")
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(output_dir, paste0(stem, ".png")), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
}

make_upper_rdm_data <- function(df, value_cols, value_names) {
  heat_long <- df %>%
    select(var1, var2, all_of(value_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(value_cols), names_to = "rdm", values_to = "dist") %>%
    mutate(
      var1 = factor(as.character(var1), levels = id_levels),
      var2 = factor(as.character(var2), levels = id_levels)
    )

  diag_data <- expand.grid(
    var1 = id_levels,
    var2 = id_levels,
    rdm = value_cols,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    filter(var1 == var2) %>%
    mutate(
      dist = 0,
      var1 = factor(var1, levels = id_levels),
      var2 = factor(var2, levels = id_levels)
    )

  bind_rows(heat_long, diag_data) %>%
    filter(as.integer(var1) <= as.integer(var2)) %>%
    mutate(rdm = factor(value_names[rdm], levels = unname(value_names)))
}

plot_upper_rdm <- function(plot_data, fill_limits, legend_title) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = var2, y = var1, fill = dist)) +
    geom_tile(color = NA) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#6F89A8", mid = "white", high = "#C97845",
      midpoint = 0, limits = fill_limits, name = legend_title
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", limits = id_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = id_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    coord_fixed() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )
}
```

## Centrality-based RDM figures

```{r centrality-rdm-figures}
network_heat_full <- make_upper_rdm_data(RDM_merge, network_cols, network_rdm_names)
network_dist_range <- range(network_heat_full$dist, na.rm = TRUE)

network_rdm_plots <- map(setNames(unname(network_rdm_names), network_cats), function(network_label) {
  plot_upper_rdm(
    network_heat_full %>% filter(rdm == network_label),
    network_dist_range,
    "Euclidean Distance (Z-score)"
  )
})

iwalk(network_rdm_plots, function(plot, network_code) {
  save_plot_bundle(plot, paste0(network_code, "_network_rdm.svg"))
})

bribe_heat_full <- bind_rows(
  behav_bribe_rdm %>% mutate(var1 = as.character(var1), var2 = as.character(var2)),
  expand.grid(var1 = id_levels, var2 = id_levels, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    filter(var1 == var2) %>% mutate(dist = 0)
) %>%
  mutate(
    var1 = factor(var1, levels = id_levels),
    var2 = factor(var2, levels = id_levels)
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(var1) <= as.integer(var2))

bribe_network_plot <- plot_upper_rdm(
  bribe_heat_full,
  range(bribe_heat_full$dist, na.rm = TRUE),
  "Euclidean Distance (Z-score)"
)
save_plot_bundle(bribe_network_plot, "bribe_network_rdm.svg")
```

## Distance-based RDM figures

```{r distance-rdm-figures}
distance_heat_full <- bind_rows(
  imap(distance_rdm_list_isrsa, function(x, nm) {
    x %>%
      select(var1, var2, dist) %>%
      mutate(rdm = distance_cols[match(nm, network_cats)])
  })
) %>%
  mutate(
    var1 = factor(as.character(var1), levels = id_levels),
    var2 = factor(as.character(var2), levels = id_levels)
  )

distance_diag <- expand.grid(
  var1 = id_levels, var2 = id_levels, rdm = distance_cols,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(var1 == var2) %>%
  mutate(
    dist = 0,
    var1 = factor(var1, levels = id_levels),
    var2 = factor(var2, levels = id_levels)
  )

distance_heat_full <- bind_rows(distance_heat_full, distance_diag) %>%
  filter(as.integer(var1) <= as.integer(var2)) %>%
  mutate(
    rdm = factor(
      network_rdm_names[sub("^distance", "network", rdm)],
      levels = unname(network_rdm_names)
    )
  )

distance_dist_range <- range(distance_heat_full$dist, na.rm = TRUE)
distance_rdm_plots <- map(setNames(unname(network_names), network_cats), function(network_label) {
  plot_upper_rdm(
    distance_heat_full %>% filter(rdm == network_label),
    distance_dist_range,
    "Shortest-path Distance (Z-score)"
  )
})

iwalk(distance_rdm_plots, function(plot, network_code) {
  save_plot_bundle(plot, paste0(network_code, "_distance_rdm.svg"))
})
```

## Centrality-behavior correlation heatmap

```{r centrality-behavior-heatmap}
centrality_behavior_heatmap <- ggplot(
  centrality_behavior_cor,
  aes(x = behavior, y = centrality_type, fill = r)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(~ network, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B6EA8", mid = "white", high = "#B4493F",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Spearman's ρ"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

save_plot_bundle(centrality_behavior_heatmap, "centrality_behavior_heatmap.svg", width = 7, height = 8)
```
